topic: From WhatsApp-run operations to platform-run operations — the SME journey in Oman, 2024 to 2026
format: Open with an Oman market data point or Vision 2040 reference, then connect it to operational reality for SMEs
post:
Seven WhatsApp groups. Three spreadsheets. And the quiet assumption that someone, somewhere, remembered to follow up.

Honestly? That's not embarrassing. For a long time, it worked.

But the rules have changed. Vision 2040 puts private sector employment at 50%. Omanization compliance is tightening. The Ministry of Labour is digitalising its filings. SPF contributions are mandatory. WPS enforcement has less patience for delays than it did even two years ago.

Businesses that grew on trust and group chats are now being held to a different standard — not necessarily bigger, just tighter.

The gap between 2024 and 2026 won't go to whoever has the best product or the sharpest pricing. It'll go to the SMEs that built the back-end to handle compliance, workforce visibility, and client delivery without something slipping through.

That's the problem SmartPRO Hub was built for — HR software Oman businesses can run in Arabic and English, with WPS, SPF, Omanization, work permit tracking, and PRO services in one place instead of scattered across five tools and a lot of hope.

The SMEs that get this right are the ones investors and government partners will want behind them.
